purpose: Compact authoritative runtime contract for the single daily AI task. Historical runbook sections remain audit documentation and are not normal Work input.
precedence: This file plus docs/operations/efficiency-operating-policy.json governs normal daily Work execution where older runbook text conflicts.

research.method: metadata-first; deterministic filtering before deep retrieval; stop when six compliant finalists plus bounded reserves are supported
research.failure: If bounded evidence cannot support six compliant stories, preserve the last valid edition and stop.
research.model_visible_discovery_rule: Do not open or summarize the raw discovery queue. Run the deterministic metadata gate and use only its candidates array as model-visible article discovery input.
discovery_sequence: Run fresh deterministic catalog discovery once with the original research cutoff supplied through DAB_RESEARCH_CUTOFF. Do not inspect the raw queue.
Run the deterministic under-80 metadata gate.

Inspect only the gate output. Continue only when coverage_ready is true, every retained candidate has a resolved in-window metadata date, all three focus hints have at least three candidates, and at least one Agent Skills signal exists.

images.style: Detailed professional story-specific textbook illustration; dominant white/near-white background; approximately 1200x630; precise instructional composition; short readable labels; safe margins; materially differentiated layouts.

work_owns: load this compact runtime contract and the machine-readable efficiency policy
fresh metadata-first discovery and bounded source verification
six full-quality image generations and image acceptance
commit one editorial-handoff manifest on an isolated editorial-handoff/* branch
github_actions_owns: validate handoff and trusted main baseline
select the six accepted generative image assets without lowering quality
run repository tests and contract validation
open or reuse protected publication PR
deterministic delta validation with zero model calls

handoff.hard_stop: After the handoff commit is pushed, the daily AI task ends. It must not run generator/tests/build/PR/CI/merge/Pages/live validation or poll any release state.
handoff.template_usage: Read this compact shape-only template instead of inspecting generator implementation code during normal Work. Replace every placeholder from fresh reviewed evidence.

production.downstream: GitHub Actions may create a publication-candidate PR and protected production promotion remains governed by policy.

qualification_nonproduction.downstream: GitHub Actions may run deterministic expansion/tests on the isolated branch but MUST NOT create a publication PR or label, merge to main, trigger Pages deployment, or promote production.

qualification_test.purpose: Allows a full scheduled-equivalent cost/structure test through the editorial handoff while deterministically proving the post-editorial stage without any production release path.
